scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn moat_api.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.dev:dispatcher: cd apps/api && uv run python -m moat_api.workers.dispatcher
scripts.dev:worker: cd apps/api && uv run python -m moat_api.workers.main --queue moat-ai-interactive
scripts.dev:worker:ocr: cd apps/api && uv run python -m moat_api.workers.main --queue moat-ocr
scripts.lint:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check src
scripts.stack:up: cd infra/compose && docker compose --profile full up -d
scripts.stack:down: cd infra/compose && docker compose --profile full down
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:seed: cd apps/api && uv run python -m moat_api.cli.seed --reset
scripts.search:reindex: cd apps/api && uv run python -m moat_api.cli.reindex
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:smoke
scripts.test:unit: cd apps/api && uv run pytest tests/ -q
scripts.test:smoke: npm run db:seed --silent && uv run --project apps/api python tests/integration/smoke_flow.py
scripts.test:load: cd apps/api && uv run locust -f ../../tests/load/locustfile.py --host http://localhost:3000
scripts.helm:lint: helm lint infra/helm/moat && helm template moat infra/helm/moat > /dev/null && echo chart renders
